title: Critical Appraisal of Fairness Metrics in Clinical Predictive AI
reasoning: The paper is a scoping review focused on the technical and clinical appraisal of fairness metrics in clinical predictive models (such as risk scores and standard machine learning). While it mentions ethical frameworks and legal principles as motivations for fairness, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/theological systems. The discussion of ethics is restricted to the normative justification for statistical fairness metrics in healthcare.
